requirements.verifier_assertion: iv_shipped_checklist item 1 — full-screen WebGL 3D scene renders thousands of small glowing particles flowing like smoke or a ghost above a dark metallic floor that reflects them, with scene fog and soft shadows. Pass: dense animated particle flow visible over a reflective floor with no blank canvas or error overlay.

iv_shipped_checklist item 2 — particle stream bends toward and swirls around the mouse position when the cursor holds in one area, forming a visible attraction point. Pass: particles visibly follow the cursor and gather near it while it moves.
iv_shipped_checklist item 3 — pressing Space toggles the simulation movement and the hint text 'Press space key to toggle movement' is present at the bottom of the screen.
must_include: Press space key to toggle movement

requirements.verifier_assertion: iv_shipped_checklist item 4 — logo fades in with a scale/blur animation (positioned right on wide screens), footer links and instruction text slide up with staggered timing during the init sequence.
must_include: scale and blur fade-in on page load
slide up from below with staggered timing
shifts right when the viewport is wider than 960 px

requirements.verifier_assertion: iv_shipped_checklist item 5 — three footer links to the author's personal website (Edan Kwan), the GitHub repository, and the YouTube video. Each visible with meaningful labels, aligned bottom-right, opens in a new tab.

iv_shipped_checklist item 6 — dat.GUI 'Simulator' folder exposes particle amount (discrete choices 64×64 to 2048×2048 with page reload), speed, die speed, radius, curl size, attraction, follow-mouse toggle. Adjusting at least one produces visible changes in particle behavior.
must_include: particle amount as a discrete selector

requirements.verifier_assertion: iv_shipped_checklist item 7 — dat.GUI 'Rendering' folder exposes shadow darkness, particle style toggle (points vs triangles), base color, fade color, background color; color controls produce immediate visible recoloring.
must_include: classic point sprites and triangle-based 'new particles'

requirements.verifier_assertion: iv_shipped_checklist item 8 — dat.GUI 'Post-Processing' folder toggles FXAA, motion blur (with distance/multiplier/quality), and bloom (with radius and amount); each toggle produces a distinguishable visual difference.

iv_shipped_checklist item 9 — orbit controls with left-drag rotation, scroll zoom; camera orbits around the particle formation, zoom is bounded, panning is disabled so the target doesn't drift off center.

Instruction requires a mobile fallback panel with a bypass link and social sharing meta tags; not directly scored by the 9 rubric items but part of the same artifact and referenced in the frontend plan (mobile-fallback section, MobileFallbackPanel, MobileBypassLink, viewport / open graph / twitter meta).
must_include: Open Graph and Twitter Card meta tags

requirements.verifier_assertion: Instruction requires plain-module state (no framework), rAF frame loop, GPGPU floating-point render targets for particle positions, two render modes (point sprites + triangle 'new particles'); required to satisfy rubric items 1, 6, 7 in the shape the plan describes.
